games.name: Avalanche of objects [Difficult 😈]
games.description:
📦Dodge objects. Reach the top. Cause chaos.

💥 Climb a massive staircase while random objects rain down! Hide behind blocks, time your runs, and try not to get crushed.
🔁 Every 10 minutes, the round resets with a new layout.
📦 Reach the top to throw objects at other players.

😎Survive. Gnome. Repeat.
